tunables.name: OPEN
tunables.reason: browser API constant WebSocket.OPEN (1): not a number we choose

tunables.name: MINUTES_PER_DAY
tunables.reason: a unit fact (24 h x 60 min = 1440 minutes in a day), not a tuning: nobody tunes how long a day is in minutes; the game day's real length is the gameDayMinutes row (Lead 2026-10-18)

tunables.name: COLUMN_SALT
tunables.reason: salt that separates the smoke columns' draws from the ridges' (golden-ratio constant): part of the seed format, not tuning

branchIds.reason: the asset family name in a ground-look row (`asset: "loot"` = loot.glb's node, else a path): a schema category the loader validates, not a content id

the page's prompt rule 'the bank is the Exchange's' compares the zone it stands in with the town zone id; the page cannot import origins/presence/zones.ts (it loads the presence registry and server frame), whose town-zones.json row carries `trade: true` for the same zone; the page's own zone rows (frontier plan) do not flag it.
